# Subbaiah NM

> Poet, writer and singer from Bangalore. Author of the poetry collection From Reverie to Requiem and singer with the band Ek Bun Samosa.

## The book
- Title: From Reverie to Requiem
- Author: Subbaiah NM
- Publisher: Notion Press, June 23 2025. 106 pages. ISBN 9798899844058.
- 22 poems, from whimsy to heartbreak: pets and eccentric characters, family, faith and love, grief and the weight of reality.
- Launched at the Mysore Literature Festival.
- Over 600 copies sold. About a year and a half in the making.
- Buy: https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0FF469Q9T , https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FF469Q9T , https://notionpress.com/in/read/from-reverie-to-requiem
- Readers can also buy a copy directly from the author through the website.

## About
- Has been writing since childhood. Wrote his first book at the age of 10.
- Sings with the band Ek Bun Samosa and plays the guitar.
- Plays Valorant and other video games, which first got him creating. Reads books and manga and watches anime.
